resources.string: Press and release the power button three times within 1.5 seconds to run your selected rotation action. Works independently of shake detection.

Connect Shizuku once to start button detection and grant system settings permission. After detection starts, wireless debugging and Shizuku can be turned off. After a reboot or GOAT process termination, connect Shizuku again to restart detection.
Power button screen on/off and system shortcuts still work. If double-press launches the camera, turn that shortcut off in Side button settings.
Button detection needs to be started. Connect Shizuku and check system settings permission.
Listening for power button presses · Wireless debugging can be turned off
Button detection stopped. Connect Shizuku to start it again; retrying automatically while connected.
Could not change rotation. Check system settings permission.
Triple-press the power button to toggle rotation lock.
Switch between locking the current direction and auto-rotate.
Turn to the direction you are holding the device, then lock again. Uses the same rotation settings as Shake to rotate; shaking does not need to be enabled.
Rotating to the device direction, then locking.
